description: No documentation of repairs and modifications to physical components of a facility related to security.
applicability: This signal applies to: Healthcare facilities and data centers Server rooms and network closets Workstations and portable devices accessing ePHI Storage media containing ePHI Physical access control systems

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Review maintenance logs and work order systems for documentation of security-related facility modifications. Verify that records exist for repairs or changes to locks, doors, walls, access control systems, surveillance equipment, and other physical security components. Check for procedures requiring documentation before and after security-related maintenance activities.
